title: Internal Hom of a coproduct is a product
statement: For a sheaf of rings R and a family of sheaf modules M indexed by I, any colimit cofan c with point c.pt induces a limit fan whose point is internalHom(c.pt,N) and whose projections are precomposition by c.inj i.

proof.text: For a presheaf map f : A → homObj M N, evaluate f_U(a) at the identity slice object to obtain the pairing b_U(a,m). Naturality of f and of each local map gives restriction compatibility of b. Construct its transpose M → homObj A N: at U, m maps to the local map whose component at W → U sends a to b_W(a,m|W). Linearity in a and m follows from the linearity of f and its values; restriction compatibility gives both required naturality laws. This is the local bilinear correspondence underlying Stacks 03EO and uses only the existing internal-Hom construction.

Evaluate the transpose twice at U, a and W → U, m. Naturality of f identifies its value with f_U(a)_W(m), so transposition is involutive. Evaluate precomposition by g : M′ → M in the same way: naturality of g gives transpose(f ≫ homObjMap g id) = g ≫ transpose(f). Both constructions lift from presheaves to sheaf morphisms because sheaf morphisms are precisely the underlying presheaf morphisms.

For a fan s with vertex A, transpose its projections into maps M i → homObj A N. Descend this family through the given colimit cofan, obtaining c.pt → homObj A N, then transpose back for the lift. Involutivity and the precomposition formula turn the fan factorization into Cofan.IsColimit.fac. For uniqueness, transpose the candidate lift and apply Cofan.IsColimit.hom_ext to its composites with all injections. Involutivity makes transposition injective. Fan.IsLimit.mk packages these data. The proof applies equally to an empty indexing type.

proof_origin.place: Section 03EK and Tag 03EO, local bilinear pairing; direct transposition argument written by H2 without tensor or sheafification

lean.statement:
theorem internalHomCoproductFanIsLimit {I : Type w} (M : I → Mod)
    (c : Cofan M) (hc : IsColimit c) (N : Mod) :
    Nonempty (IsLimit (Fan.mk (homObj (R := R) c.pt N)
      (fun i ↦ homObjMap (R := R) (c.inj i) (𝟙 N))))
